question: A tourist group plto visit six places A, B, C, D, E and F on different days of the same week (starting on Monday and ending on Saturday) during their tour. They visited place D on Monday. They visited only one place between visiting place B and place D. They visited place F the immediate next day of visiting place C. They neither visited place C nor place A on Thursday. On which day did they visit place E?
